# Effect: chorus

Chorus: layers slightly detuned copies to thicken and widen the sound.

**Where to put it**: Good for pad, electric piano, guitar and chords; put it before the reverb. Use with care on bass (low-frequency phase cancellation).

Latest parameters: `muser effects chorus` (MCP: `describe_effect`)

## Parameters

| Parameter | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rate_hz` | 0.8 | 0 – 100 Hz | Modulation rate. 0.2-1 slow and natural; 2-5 obvious wobble |
| `depth_ms` | 3 | 0 – 50 ms | Modulation depth. 1-3 subtle; 5-10 obviously detuned |
| `mix` | 0.4 | 0 – 1 | Dry/wet mix. 0.3-0.5 normal |

All parameters can be omitted and take their default when omitted; when a value is out of range, `muser validate` reports the exact location.

## Minimal example

```json
{ "type": "chorus", "rate_hz": 0.6, "depth_ms": 4, "mix": 0.5 }
```

## Scenario presets

- Slight thickening (electric piano, pad)

  ```json
  {"type": "chorus", "rate_hz": 0.5, "depth_ms": 2.0, "mix": 0.3}
  ```

- 80s wide synth

  ```json
  {"type": "chorus", "rate_hz": 0.8, "depth_ms": 5.0, "mix": 0.5}
  ```

- Obvious wobble (special effect)

  ```json
  {"type": "chorus", "rate_hz": 3.0, "depth_ms": 6.0, "mix": 0.5}
  ```

## Tips and common mistakes

- Chorus on bass makes the low frequencies phase-cancel and sound hollow; if you need it, keep mix <= 0.2.
- Put chorus before reverb.
